result.summary: The main defect is the bottom navigation bar, which ignores the device's bottom safe area. Its icons are pushed partly off-screen and the system gesture handle overlaps them. The rest of the page appears to render correctly.

issues.description: The bottom tab bar (Home, Search, Orders, Profile) sits too low. The bottom portion of each icon is clipped by the screen edge, and any tab labels are fully hidden. The bar seems to ignore the bottom safe-area inset.
issues.suggestion: Add bottom padding equal to the safe-area inset (e.g., env(safe-area-inset-bottom) or WindowInsets) so the full tab bar, icons and labels sit above the screen edge.

issues.description: The system gesture/home indicator bar is drawn directly over the Search and Orders tab icons. This obscures them and makes those tabs harder to recognize and tap, with a risk of triggering the system gesture instead.
issues.suggestion: Lay out the navigation bar above the system gesture area by respecting the gesture insets, so no tappable icons sit beneath the home indicator.
